thread:
Alex: opened a PR to make the Go client prefer region-aware pools for tool calls when available — adds a small config flag `EnableRegionalRouting` and updates routing order. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-client/pull/2410  

Alex: would love quick eyes before tomorrow's deploy window. should be low-risk but touches the selection logic. tagging y'all: @Maria @Jordan @Sam :pray:

Maria: I'll grab it after stand and try to get a review by EOD. quick skim looks fine from the API side.

Jordan: skimmed — overall approach is sensible. question about behavior when regional pool is present but has zero capacity: do we immediately fall back to global pool, or try other regional pools first? add a unit test for empty-regional-pool fallback.

Sam: small suggestion: naming `RouteSelector` -> `RouteResolver` felt clearer in the code. not blocking, but if you're already editing might be good. also a one-line comment on `SelectRoute(ctx, req)` detailing invariants would help future readers.

Alex: thanks — will add the fallback test, rename, and a comment. pushing an update in ~20m.

CI-bot: build #4599 failed on linux-amd64: TestRouteSelector_Race (panic: concurrent map read/write). Full logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/4599/logs  

Alex: seeing the race in the shared route cache under test. locally making a per-request shallow copy of the cache in the test removed the flake. updating implementation to use a read-copy-on-write pattern for cache mutations and adding a deterministic test that exercises concurrent calls.

Maria: left an inline nit about a docstring and asked for a changelog line for the behavior change. otherwise LGTM after CI. :+1:

Jordan: approved the fallback unit test and the concurrent test. once CI passes I'm good. lgtm.

Alex: pushed fix + tests -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-client/pull/2410/files  

CI-bot: build #4600 started.

CI-bot: build #4600 passed :white_check_mark: (linux-amd64, darwin-arm64)

Alex: merging now. will watch canary and report back. :rocket:

Deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for 2026-03-18 03:15 UTC for service-go-client (sha: b7c4d2e). Notifying eng-sre and eng-platform.

Sam: great turnaround — thanks for the quick fix and tests.

Alex: thanks everyone for the quick reviews and help!
